sermons.title: Sermon 400 | Our Miseries, Messengers of Mercy

scripture.verse: "Come, and let us return unto the Lord: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten and he will bind us up. After two days he will revive us: in the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his sight."
"And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the Lord in this place; and I knew it not."

sermons.title: Sermon 402 | The Joint Heirs and Their Divine Portion

scripture.verse: "And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee: but"
"And the Lord turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends."

sermons.title: Sermon 405 | The Triumphal Entry Into Jerusalem

scripture.verse: "Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass."

sermons.title: Sermon 406 | The Infallibility of God's Purpose

scripture.verse: "But he is in one minds, and who can turn him? and what his soul desireth, even that he doeth.
"But the natural man receiveth not the things of the spirit of God, neither can he know then because they are spiritually discerned."
